meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: Anthropic Launches 'Claude for Small Business' — Pre-Built Workflows in QuickBooks, HubSpot, PayPal, and More
entries.summary: Anthropic launched Claude for Small Business, a toggle-install package inside Claude Cowork with connectors to QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, DocuSign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365. It ships with 15 ready-to-run agentic workflows (payroll planning, month-end close, invoice chasing, campaign creation) and 15 skills for repeatable SMB tasks. SMB owners: this is the most direct path yet to running Claude inside the tools you already use — just connect your stack and click a workflow.

entries.title: Anthropic Acquires Stainless, Winding Down Hosted SDK Generator — Signal for the MCP Ecosystem
entries.summary: Anthropic acquired Stainless, the leader in SDK generation and MCP server tooling — it has generated every official Anthropic SDK since launch. As part of the acqui-hire, all hosted Stainless products are being wound down (no new signups or SDK generation). For SMB owners: this signals Anthropic's push toward closed Claude Platform connectivity. Existing generated SDKs remain yours to use and extend, but watch for platform-dependent tooling as a potential lock-in risk when building custom Claude skills.

entries.title: Cloudflare Tests Mythos Against 50+ Repos — 'Exploit Chain Construction' Is a Different Class of Tool
entries.summary: Cloudflare ran Anthropic's Mythos Preview against 50+ internal repositories in Project Glasswing and found it can chain multiple security primitives into working exploits — a leap from simple bug finding. For SMBs: security-focused AI is maturing fast. Consider using Claude Cowork for vulnerability scanning of your own web code, APIs, and infrastructure configs before attackers leverage the same capabilities.
